feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 7 October 2026 10:14pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 07 October 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Transient ridge of high pressure will build over the area tonight.


##Wind##

Northwest 5 or 6, backing west or northwest 3 or 4 tomorrow morning, then west or southwest 4 or 5 in the afternoon, increasing 5 to 7 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming slight tomorrow morning, then building moderate again tomorrow evening.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then rain arriving from the west tomorrow afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 to 7, veering west or southwest overnight into Friday, then veering west Friday morning.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate.


##Weather##

Rain, heavy at times, clearing to showers Friday morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or showers.
